paper.title_en: Quasiclassical theory of nonlinear response in d-wave superconductors
paper.abstract_en: Motivated by recent THz pump-probe experiments in unconventional superconductors, in this paper we use Keldysh--Nambu quasiclassical theory of $d$-wave superconductors to analyze the third-harmonic generation. A systematic perturbative solution of the out-of-equilibrium Eilenberger equation for the Keldysh propagator is developed with respect to the amplitude of an external electromagnetic field. We show that in a clean superconductor and for a spatially uniform electromagnetic field third harmonic response is absent. In the presence of elastic impurity scattering which we treat using the self-consistent scattering matrix approximation in the Born limit we find that the third-harmonic current density is a sum of the Higgs (amplitude) mode and quasiparticle contributions. We compute their dependence on disorder, temperature, frequency and polarization of external radiation.
